reason: With 11.11 coming, LKR 560 for 1,000 SMS is small enough to try once as a test, and it costs less than one boosted post. I would only buy the smallest pack, send to a slice of my list and see whether anyone actually walks in.
objection: I am not sure my customers read SMS offers at all, or if they just delete them like the other promo messages they get. Also I have no idea how long the business name approval takes, and an offer from an unknown number looks like spam.
would_change_my_mind: If I can't get my shop name approved before 11.11, I would not bother and would just put the money into Facebook again.
